en.text: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to the LORD, the God of Israel,

zhSimplified.text: 犹大和便雅悯的敌人听说被掳归回的人为耶和华—以色列的 神建造殿宇，

zhTraditional.text: 猶大和便雅憫的敵人聽說被擄歸回的人為耶和華－以色列的上帝建造殿宇，

en.text: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

zhSimplified.text: 就去见所罗巴伯和以色列的族长，对他们说：「请容我们与你们一同建造；因为我们寻求你们的 神，与你们一样。自从亚述王以撒哈顿带我们上这地以来，我们常祭祀 神。」

zhTraditional.text: 就去見所羅巴伯和以色列的族長，對他們說：「請容我們與你們一同建造；因為我們尋求你們的上帝，與你們一樣。自從亞述王以撒哈頓帶我們上這地以來，我們常祭祀上帝。」

en.text: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to the LORD, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

zhSimplified.text: 但所罗巴伯、耶书亚，和其余以色列的族长对他们说：「我们建造 神的殿与你们无干，我们自己为耶和华—以色列的 神协力建造，是照波斯王塞鲁士所吩咐的。」

zhTraditional.text: 但所羅巴伯、耶書亞，和其餘以色列的族長對他們說：「我們建造上帝的殿與你們無干，我們自己為耶和華－以色列的上帝協力建造，是照波斯王塞魯士所吩咐的。」

en.text: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

zhSimplified.text: 那地的民，就在犹大人建造的时候，使他们的手发软，扰乱他们；

zhTraditional.text: 那地的民，就在猶大人建造的時候，使他們的手發軟，擾亂他們；

en.text: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

zhSimplified.text: 从波斯王塞鲁士年间，直到波斯王大流士登基的时候，贿买谋士，要败坏他们的谋算。

zhTraditional.text: 從波斯王塞魯士年間，直到波斯王大流士登基的時候，賄買謀士，要敗壞他們的謀算。

en.text: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 在亚哈随鲁才登基的时候，上本控告犹大和耶路撒冷的居民。

zhTraditional.text: 在亞哈隨魯才登基的時候，上本控告猶大和耶路撒冷的居民。

en.text: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.

zhSimplified.text: 亚达薛西年间，比施兰、米特利达、他别，和他们的同党上本奏告波斯王亚达薛西。本章是用亚兰文字，亚兰方言。

zhTraditional.text: 亞達薛西年間，比施蘭、米特利達、他別，和他們的同黨上本奏告波斯王亞達薛西。本章是用亞蘭文字，亞蘭方言。

en.text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.

zhSimplified.text: 省长利宏、书记伸帅要控告耶路撒冷人，也上本奏告亚达薛西王。

zhTraditional.text: 省長利宏、書記伸帥要控告耶路撒冷人，也上本奏告亞達薛西王。

en.text: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

zhSimplified.text: 省长利宏、书记伸帅，和同党的底拿人、亚法萨提迦人、他毗拉人、亚法撒人、亚基卫人、巴比伦人、书珊迦人、底亥人、以拦人，

zhTraditional.text: 省長利宏、書記伸帥，和同黨的底拿人、亞法薩提迦人、他毗拉人、亞法撒人、亞基衛人、巴比倫人、書珊迦人、底亥人、以攔人，

en.text: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.

zhSimplified.text: 和尊大的亚斯那巴所迁移、安置在撒马利亚城，并大河西一带地方的人等，

zhTraditional.text: 和尊大的亞斯那巴所遷移、安置在撒馬利亞城，並大河西一帶地方的人等，

en.text: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, from your servants, the people beyond the River.

zhSimplified.text: 上奏亚达薛西王说：「河西的臣民云云：

zhTraditional.text: 上奏亞達薛西王說：「河西的臣民云云：

en.text: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.

zhSimplified.text: 王该知道，从王那里上到我们这里的犹大人，已经到耶路撒冷重建这反叛恶劣的城，筑立根基，建造城墙。

zhTraditional.text: 王該知道，從王那裏上到我們這裏的猶大人，已經到耶路撒冷重建這反叛惡劣的城，築立根基，建造城牆。

en.text: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

zhSimplified.text: 如今王该知道，他们若建造这城，城墙完毕就不再与王进贡，交课，纳税，终久王必受亏损。

zhTraditional.text: 如今王該知道，他們若建造這城，城牆完畢就不再與王進貢，交課，納稅，終久王必受虧損。

en.text: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,

zhSimplified.text: 我们既食御盐，不忍见王吃亏，因此奏告于王。

zhTraditional.text: 我們既食御鹽，不忍見王吃虧，因此奏告於王。

en.text: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

zhSimplified.text: 请王考察先王的实录，必在其上查知这城是反叛的城，与列王和各省有害；自古以来，其中常有悖逆的事，因此这城曾被拆毁。

zhTraditional.text: 請王考察先王的實錄，必在其上查知這城是反叛的城，與列王和各省有害；自古以來，其中常有悖逆的事，因此這城曾被拆毀。

en.text: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

zhSimplified.text: 我们谨奏王知，这城若再建造，城墙完毕，河西之地王就无分了。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們謹奏王知，這城若再建造，城牆完畢，河西之地王就無分了。」

en.text: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace.

zhSimplified.text: 那时王谕复省长利宏、书记伸帅，和他们的同党，就是住撒马利亚并河西一带地方的人，说：「愿你们平安云云。

zhTraditional.text: 那時王諭覆省長利宏、書記伸帥，和他們的同黨，就是住撒馬利亞並河西一帶地方的人，說：「願你們平安云云。

en.text: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

zhSimplified.text: 你们所上的本，已经明读在我面前。

zhTraditional.text: 你們所上的本，已經明讀在我面前。

en.text: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

zhSimplified.text: 我已命人考查，得知此城古来果然背叛列王，其中常有反叛悖逆的事。

zhTraditional.text: 我已命人考查，得知此城古來果然背叛列王，其中常有反叛悖逆的事。

en.text: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.

zhSimplified.text: 从前耶路撒冷也有大君王统管河西全地，人就给他们进贡，交课，纳税。

zhTraditional.text: 從前耶路撒冷也有大君王統管河西全地，人就給他們進貢，交課，納稅。

en.text: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

zhSimplified.text: 现在你们要出告示命这些人停工，使这城不得建造，等我降旨。

zhTraditional.text: 現在你們要出告示命這些人停工，使這城不得建造，等我降旨。

en.text: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

zhSimplified.text: 你们当谨慎，不可迟延，为何容害加重，使王受亏损呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 你們當謹慎，不可遲延，為何容害加重，使王受虧損呢？」

en.text: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

zhSimplified.text: 亚达薛西王的上谕读在利宏和书记伸帅，并他们的同党面前，他们就急忙往耶路撒冷去见犹大人，用势力强迫他们停工。

zhTraditional.text: 亞達薛西王的上諭讀在利宏和書記伸帥，並他們的同黨面前，他們就急忙往耶路撒冷去見猶大人，用勢力強迫他們停工。

en.text: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，在耶路撒冷 神殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大流士第二年。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，在耶路撒冷上帝殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大流士第二年。
